mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation exceeds 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market and robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicate a tightening monetary policy during a labor market slowdown, which increases financial stress and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening during labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output level below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates a contraction in industrial production, signaling reduced corporate output and earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during manufacturing slowdown regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.
